backend/main.mo: Primary Motoko actor defining user profiles, members, financial and attendance records, groups, and related data structures with access control and migration initialization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining the old actor data layout and a no-op run function that returns the provided state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence flags.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing summaries of all main frontend components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for node modules, build outputs, environment files, IDE configs, OS artifacts, and Android build directories.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Android app Gradle config defining SDK versions, build types, dependencies, APK output, and optional Google services integration.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawab: Vector drawable defining the launcher icon background with a solid green rectangle.
Vector drawable defining the launcher icon foreground with circular white shapes.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap: Round adaptive launcher icon referencing the same background and foreground drawables.
Adaptive launcher icon combining background and foreground drawables.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Android color resource definitions for primary, dark primary, and accent colors.
Android theme definitions, including base, no-action-bar, and splash-compatible themes.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Top-level Gradle build configuration specifying repositories, Android Gradle plugin, Google services plugin, and a clean task.
frontend/android/gradle.properties: Gradle project-wide settings including memory, AndroidX, parallel builds, caching, and R8 configuration.
frontend/BUILD_ANDROID.md: Guide explaining prerequisites and steps for building the Android APK using Capacitor and Android Studio.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration specifying app metadata, web directory, Android scheme, navigation rules, and APK build options.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers and defines extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the app root and main TypeScript module with PWA metadata.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, theme, start URL, and Android icon resources.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures authentication and startup gates, loading states, and routing setup for the app.
Displays section committee roles and provides dialogs for assigning members to committee positions.
frontend/src/components/financial/Financ: Dialog rendering detailed financial report info including grouped entries, vows, and income/expense breakdowns.
frontend/src/components/GeneratedAssetsP: Hidden component that references generated Android assets to ensure they are included in builds.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupFina: Manages group financial reports with create, edit, delete dialogs and lists sorted reports.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout component handling header, navigation, section display, mobile menu, logout, and page structure.
frontend/src/components/StartupErrorScre: Error screen card shown on startup failures with retry support and optional error details.
frontend/src/components/SyncStatus.tsx: Shows a small sync indicator with last sync timestamp based on fetch and mutation activity.
frontend/src/contexts/SectionContext.tsx: Provides section state, saving user-selected section to profile, and utilities for section labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, reinitializing queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context including login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profiles, members, financial reports, and other backend data using a safe actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeActor.ts: Creates a resilient backend actor with retry support and optional admin token initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useStartupRetry.ts: Provides a retry mechanism to reinitialize the actor and refresh the user profile on startup failures.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme variables, layout resets, and global styling constraints.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entrypoint setting up React, Internet Identity provider, query client, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Manages attendance records: listing, creating, editing, deleting, and triggering alerts for consecutive absences.
Handles financial report CRUD, totals calculation, and viewing detailed report breakdowns.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Provides group management including CRUD, member assignments, and viewing group financial reports.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple login screen using Internet Identity with a branded UI.
frontend/src/pages/MembersPage.tsx: Implements member directory with search plus member CRUD functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Manages program schedules with CRUD operations and member role assignments.
frontend/src/pages/SectionSelectPage.tsx: Renders a setup/section selection page allowing users to enter a name, choose a section, and save their profile.
frontend/src/utils/attendanceConsecutive: Provides a function to detect members with three or more consecutive absences from attendance records.
frontend/src/utils/memberAge.ts: Calculates a member's age from a birthdate and formats it for display with fallback handling.
frontend/src/utils/startupDiagnostics.ts: Utility helpers for normalizing, sanitizing, summarizing, and logging errors during startup.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, layout settings, animations, and enabled plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing state, issues, existing features, and startup crash–related requirements.
